name: Cannabidivarin
summary: Cannabidivarin (CBDV, GWP42006) is a non-intoxicating psychoactive cannabinoid found in Cannabis. It is a homolog (chemistry) of cannabidiol (CBD), with the side-chain shortened by two methylene bridges (CH2 units).

uses.text: It is being actively developed by GW Pharmaceuticals (as GWP42006) because of a demonstrated neurochemical pathway for previously observed anti-epileptic and anti-convulsive action.

pharmacology.en: It does not cause intoxication and binds only weakly to cannabinoid receptors. Lab studies suggest it acts on TRP channels, a family of ion channels involved in pain and nerve signalling, but how it reduces seizures is not fully understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它不會造成迷醉感，與大麻素受體的結合也很弱。實驗室研究顯示它會作用於 TRP 通道，這是一類與疼痛和神經訊號有關的離子通道，但它如何減少癲癇發作仍未完全清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它不会造成迷醉感，与大麻素受体的结合也很弱。实验室研究显示它会作用于 TRP 信道，这是一类与疼痛和神经信号有关的离子信道，但它如何减少癫痫发作仍未完全清楚。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Its close relative cannabidiol can cause tiredness, sleepiness, diarrhoea and changes in appetite.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。它的近親大麻二酚可能造成疲倦、嗜睡、腹瀉與食慾改變。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。它的近亲大麻二酚可能造成疲倦、嗜睡、腹泻与食欲改变。

fact.en: The "varin" cannabinoids have a three-carbon side chain instead of the usual five, because the plant builds them from divarinic acid rather than olivetolic acid.
fact.zh: 名稱帶有「varin」的大麻素，側鏈只有三個碳，而不是常見的五個碳，因為植物是用二次甲基苔色酸（divarinic acid）而不是橄欖醇酸來合成它們。
fact.zhHans: 名称带有「varin」的大麻素，侧链只有三个碳，而不是常见的五个碳，因为植物是用二次甲基苔色酸（divarinic acid）而不是橄榄醇酸来合成它们。
